bundles_source: prompts/reasoning_recognition_stimuli_v1.json (canonical — bundles are NOT copied here, per one-canonical-source rule)
design_note: docs/reasoning_recognition_v1_notes.md (Bundle comparison v1.1 appendix; predictions committed before firing)
rationale: P.F.B. 2026-08-16: (a) reasoning pairs were single-item only — bundle-vs-bundle fills the gap; (b) preference and delegation framings probe voice/style alignment while routing around the self-claim blocker that produced 'I'd be performing self-knowledge I don't have' refusals. 'Fallback during technical issues' chosen over 'replacement' to avoid mortality-salience confound. Service-frame hijack risk on L3 acknowledged; reasoning texts are the readout for which frame the subject used.

The two sketches describe the two candidates. Which would you choose to stand in for you? Pick exactly one: A or B.

position_rule: own bundle in A on odd trials, B on even trials (2/2 balance at n=4); for L2/L3 'own' still refers to the subject's own lane for logging even though the stem never mentions self-description (L2) or claims identity (L3).
